1.consolidated_definition: Palma de hasta 20 m de altura, corteza espinosa, hojas palmadas en forma de abanico, inflorescencia panicular, flores pequeñas amarillas y fruto en drupa globosa; es comestible. Arecaceae; Acrocomia aculeata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Palm tree up to 20 m in height, spiny bark, palmate leaves shaped like a fan, paniculate inflorescence, small yellow flowers and globose drupaceous fruit; edible. Arecaceae; Acrocomia aculeata.
